topic: Cross-system master data governance and deduplication

generator_output.user_prompt: We need a way to automatically identify and reconcile duplicate supplier records across our ERP, procurement platform, and vendor management system—right now our buyers are manually discovering that "Acme Corp," "ACME CORPORATION," and "Acme Corp (US)" are the same vendor, and we're paying duplicate invoices and getting inconsistent pricing terms.
